It also says the file labels doors E1/E2 while Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet uses 01/02. A ticket number is an operational fact, and Hollis leads the Central team, so no approval was needed.

One wording slip: my reply says the doors are "still" labelled E1/E2. I only know that was true on 9 Jun. Nothing I found says whether it has been fixed since.
